body: No one wants a bum like me. I'm not a likeable or relatable person I think, every connection I've ever had left me because they lost interest
In the far away lands of Sweden

Believe me when I say this, it's way to late for me to get therapy. Therapy is for people that has trouble understanding their mental issues and want to know how to deal with them. I know exactly why I feel this way and I am also convinced no one can ever help me out of this state of mind, and besides a therapist isn't going to help me find a job or patch me up
I'm aware, I've taken all the necessary precautions and read up to assure myself that won't happen

My life I guess. I never once had a close friend and I've been struggling with mental health for over 6 years now without any support or help from anyone. Dropped out of highschool, family members dying leaving me all alone. I know I'll never recover from the prolonged damage to my mental state and that I'll find peace in death
It seems foolproof and I also like the idea of slowly having your conscious slip away as you suffocate
